description: The honest default for the first health-data slice: weight on actual measurement instants and sleep summed by wake date. Source is always visible; the device label defaults to stable device era and can be switched to the raw source/device name. Missing rows stay missing, self-reported values stay labelled, and no query touches excluded or nested-stage data.

list.name: device_label
list.label: Device label
list.description: Device era is stable across renames. Raw source/device name shows the archive's own label and may split or join renamed devices.
list.query: Device era : era,Raw source/device name : raw

title: Health Trends

panels.title: Weight — measured shape over time
panels.description: One point per stored observation at its real measurement instant. There is no daily fill and no Power Sync data in the store. The self-reported suffix is data provenance, not a heuristic. Lines disconnect across gaps longer than 180 days, while the stable device-era label prevents the 2015 no-device island from being stitched to Aria 2.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  start_utc AS time,
  value_num::double precision AS value,
  concat_ws(
    ' · ',
    source,
    CASE ${device_label:sqlstring}
      WHEN 'era' THEN COALESCE(device, 'No device stated')
      WHEN 'raw' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(raw_source_name, ''), 'No raw source/device name')
    END,
    CASE WHEN value_provenance = 'self_reported' THEN 'self-reported' END
  ) AS metric
FROM health.v_observation
WHERE record_type_code = 'body_mass'
  AND $__timeFilter(start_utc)
ORDER BY 1

WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT
    floor(min(value_num) / 10.0) * 10.0 AS lower_bound,
    ceil(max(value_num) / 10.0) * 10.0 AS upper_bound
  FROM health.v_observation
  WHERE record_type_code = 'body_mass'
    AND $__timeFilter(start_utc)
)
SELECT $__timeFrom() AS time, lower_bound::double precision AS value, '__weight_axis_bounds__' AS metric
FROM bounds
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeTo() AS time, upper_bound::double precision AS value, '__weight_axis_bounds__' AS metric
FROM bounds
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Sleep — total asleep time by wake date
panels.description: Session minutes are summed within wake date, source, route and device. Naps therefore add to their day; nested stages are not queried. Source remains visible in every label, so the concurrent Apple and Samsung period stays as two series. A gap of one missing day is disconnected, including the real 27-day April 2019 gap and the empty 2017–2018 interval.

targets.rawSql:
WITH labelled AS (
  SELECT
    local_date::timestamp AS time,
    source_code,
    route,
    device_era,
    value_provenance,
    value_num,
    concat_ws(
      ' · ',
      source,
      CASE ${device_label:sqlstring}
        WHEN 'era' THEN COALESCE(device, 'No device stated')
        WHEN 'raw' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(raw_source_name, ''), 'No raw source/device name')
      END,
      CASE WHEN value_provenance <> 'measured' THEN replace(value_provenance::text, '_', '-') END
    ) AS metric
  FROM health.v_observation
  WHERE record_type_code = 'sleep_session'
    AND local_date BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date
)
SELECT
  time,
  (sum(value_num) / 60.0)::double precision AS value,
  metric
FROM labelled
GROUP BY time, metric, source_code, route, device_era, value_provenance
ORDER BY 1, 3
